messages:
julie (customer): Hey team — we're seeing 403s from the embeddings endpoint since this morning. Same API key that was working yesterday. Error: "403 Forbidden: missing scope embeddings.generate". Using our server key via CI. Repro: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_live_***\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"model":"openembed-2","input":"foo"}'
```
Response: 
```
{
  "error": {
    "code": 403,
    "message": "missing scope: embeddings.generate",
    "hint": "token scopes: [\"inference.generate\"]"
  }
}
```
Can you confirm this isn't something on our side? We're on a prod deploy window right now and this blocks a release.

maya (CS): Thanks for the report, julie. Sorry for the interruption. Can you paste the account id and the key id (if available)? Also did anything change in your CI/token provisioning in the last 24h? :eyes:

julie (customer): account: acct_42G7, key id: key_9ab3. We haven't touched provisioning — the pipeline reprovision step didn't run last night but nothing was intentionally changed.

maya (CS): ok trying a quick lookup. Liam / akshay, can you check token metadata for acct_42G7 / key_9ab3? Might be a scope regression.

deploy-bot: Token rotate job for acct_42G7 completed 2024-10-18T02:05:04Z (job id jr-983).

liam (eng): pulling token record now. CLI: 
```
redwoodctl tokens get --id key_9ab3 --account acct_42G7
```
returned: 
```
{
  "id": "key_9ab3",
  "scopes": ["inference.generate"],
  "created_at": "2024-10-18T02:05:04Z"
}
```
So the token only has inference.generate, no embeddings or rerank scopes. That matches the error.

julie (customer): but we used embeddings yesterday using the same key... any idea why rotate job would drop scopes?

akshay (sre): quick theory: our rotate job replaces service tokens from a template and a bug in the template omitted extra scopes. I've flagged jr-983. For immediate unblock you can: 
1) Create a new token in Console with scopes: inference.generate, embeddings.generate, rerank.run (recommended minimal set).
2) Replace the key in your CI secrets and re-deploy.

Example create via API: 
```
POST /v1/tokens
Authorization: Bearer org_admin_key
Body: {"account":"acct_42G7","name":"ci-emb-unblock","scopes":["inference.generate","embeddings.generate","rerank.run"]}
```
Response will include the key string. Make sure to rotate safely.

liam (eng): I also ran a quick grep in the rotate job template. Found the bug: the old templates used \"scopes\": [\"inference.generate\",\"embeddings.generate\",\"rerank.run\"] but the new template had a misplaced conditional and produced only [\"inference.generate\"]. I'm opening a PR to fix the template and will backfill an audit to find affected accounts.

maya (CS): Julie, can you try creating a temp key with the three scopes and confirm embeddings + rerank work? If that fixes it we can coordinate secret swap and close.

julie (customer): created new key via Console (ci-emb-unblock). Replaced CI secret and kicked the job — embeddings succeeded. Rerank endpoint also returns 200 now.

julie (customer): thanks — we'll hold deploy until you confirm no broader regressions.

liam (eng): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/721 (fixes template and adds unit test). Also adding a backfill script to re-issue missing scopes for rotate jobs between 2024-10-18T00:00 and 2024-10-18T03:00.

akshay (sre): backfill plan: run in audit mode first and DM impacted accounts, then apply changes to tokens that were auto-rotated and have mismatched scopes. Will drop a status update in this thread when audit completes.

maya (CS): I'll email impacted customers in the morning and offer assisted rotation if they want. For julie: feel free to reopen if anything else pops up. :v:
